BETWEEN:-
 SUNIL NORIYA S/O SHRI GUDDA NORIYA, AGED ABOUT  22 YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O VILLAGE  HIRAPUR PS. AND TEHSIL TENDUKHEDA DISTRICT  NARSINGHPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MANOK KUSHWAHA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION TENDUKHEDA DISTRICT  NARSINGHPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. VICTIM X D/O
NOT MENTION NOT MENTION  (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY SHRI Y.D. YADAV - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail, who is in jail since 26.03.2023 relating to FIR No.01/2023 registered at Police Station Tendukheda District Narsinghpur (M.P.) for the offences under sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5L/6, 5(j)(ii) of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that the applicant is aged about 22 years and prosecutrix is also aged about 17 years and she was a consenting party.
Applicant has not committed rape with prosecutrix.
He has falsely been implicated in the case.

In these circumstances,
Sunil Noriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23105028/
1 applicant may be granted bail.

sentences.text:
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and read over the statement of prosecutrix recorded under section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
4.
Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is aged about more than 16 years.
Applicant is a young man of 22 years of age.
He is in custody since 26.03.2023.
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C.
as per rules.
